input.sha256_scope: No image input. Every case is an integer contour written out in the capture tool (eleven named, forty from a seeded LCG), and the probability map is a closed form reproduced identically in the Rust test.

upstream.capture_method: box_score_slow was loaded by file path with `paddle` stubbed (the module dereferences it at import for a code path this capture never reaches) and executed. The fillPoly masks are extracted alongside, because the score alone under-constrains the fill: a wrong mask can produce a right mean.

limitations: The eleven named cases derived the fill rules; the forty seeded polygons verify them on shapes that played no part in the derivation. All fifty-one match bit for bit.
Contour coordinates outside i32 are refused where upstream's astype('int32') would silently wrap them; recorded as an intentional difference.
The slow mode is unreachable from the frozen PP-OCRv6_medium_det configuration, whose score_mode defaults to fast. This fixture makes the mode available and verified, not selected.
